title: The Live Balance Behind a Circle Reward Point Release
content:
## The live balance a Circle redemption starts from

The live balance is measured over one of three spans on a Northbeam Circle Membership, and which one follows
whether the tier issues a yearly points statement and whether a sweep entry stands in the twelve months
ending on the handling day.

1. Where the tier issues a yearly points statement and a sweep entry stands in the twelve months ending on the
   handling day, the live balance is the points earned inside the expiry months of the tier less the points
   spent and the points swept inside that same window.
2. Where the tier issues a yearly points statement and no sweep entry stands in that window, the live balance
   is the points earned in the thirty-six months ending on the handling day less the points spent and the
   points swept in that window.
3. Where neither of those holds, the live balance is the points earned over the whole ledger less every point
   spent and every point swept.

## The two tier entries the readings turn on

| Tier | Yearly points statement issued | Expiry months of the tier |
|---|---|---|
| Circle Free Membership | no | 12 |
| Circle Plus Annual | yes | 18 |
| Circle Total Annual | yes | 24 |
| Circle Total Household Annual | yes | 24 |
| Circle Business Pro | yes | 24 |
| Circle Business Elite | yes | 36 |

The second reading is measured over 36 months ending on the handling day whatever the tier's expiry months
come to.

## Cases on the three readings

A member on Circle Plus Annual whose ledger carries a sweep entry booked four months ago has a live balance of
the points earned in the 18 months ending on the handling day less the points spent and swept in those same 18
months.

The same member with no sweep entry inside the twelve months has a live balance measured over 36 months
instead.

A member on Circle Free Membership, whose tier issues no yearly points statement, falls to the third reading
whatever the ledger carries, and the live balance is the whole ledger netted off. In each case the three
amounts are drawn from the same span, so points earned outside it are not netted against spending inside it.

## What the balance must carry

No points are released until the balance carries the sweep entry owed for the calendar year the
handling day falls in.
